To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the relationship between poverty and health is complex and multidimensional; 2) the relationship between health and poverty is reciprocal; 3) the relationship between income and health is not linear, but U shaped; and 4) the relationship between the health of the poor and that of non-poor varies with the measure of health used, the age group studied, and the time period studied.
